title: explorhub-mcp-server is a malicious npm package
summary: The npm package explorhub-mcp-server contains embedded malicious code (CWE-506); every published version is affected. Identified by the OpenSSF malicious-packages project and published as GHSA-2qjx-pmc9-2jrj / OSV MAL-2026-4312. Any machine that installed or launched it (e.g. via `npx explorhub-mcp-server` in an MCP client config) should be treated as compromised: remove the package and rotate secrets.
